title: Efforts and Manpower Required to Disseminate Grow Well SG Recommendations and Guidance on Screen Use in Children
what_it_is: Efforts and Manpower Required to Disseminate Grow Well SG Recommendations and Guidance on Screen Use in Children

sections.label: Health guidelines conveyed to parents
sections.summary: Health guidelines including children's screen time will reach parents through the annual health screening programme in mainstream schools to prepare children's health plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Besides leveraging mass media, the health guidelines including screen time for children, will be conveyed to parents via the annual health screening programme in mainstream schools to prepare children's health plans.

sections.label: Screening and consultation duration
sections.summary: The whole screening and consultation process for each child may take about 30 minutes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The entire process of screening and consultation for each child may take about 30 minutes.

sections.label: No additional manpower deployed
sections.summary: Because the Health Plan taps MOE and HPB's existing processes, no additional manpower is being deployed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As the implementation of the Health Plan largely taps on MOE and HPB's existing processes, we are not deploying additional manpower.

sections.label: Annual Lifestyle Questionnaire data
sections.summary: The annual Lifestyle Questionnaire given to parents as part of the Health Plans will contain self-reported data on children's lifestyle habits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The annual Lifestyle Questionnaire provided to parents as part of the Health Plans, will contain self-reported data on lifestyle habits of their children.

sections.label: Developing Health Plans for children
sections.summary: Schools have long done health screening and discussed lifestyle habits, but now Health Plans with clearer guidelines, especially on screen time, are developed and parents engaged through schools.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: For years they have been going down to school doing health screening, talking to the kids about lifestyle habits, but now, we deliberately develop a Health Plan for children with clearer guidelines, especially on screen time and then through the school, engage the parents.

sections.label: Updating guidelines with new findings
sections.summary: Guidelines will be updated from time to time as new findings appear, with Grow Well SG taking an evidence-based approach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As and when we see new findings, we will update the guidelines from time to time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But essentially, we are taking an evidence-based approach to Grow Well SG.

sections.label: Parents need parenting guidelines
sections.summary: Parents need practical step-by-step guidelines to improve their parenting skills.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Ultimately, parents need practical step-by-step guidelines for them to improve their parenting skills.
